top_categories.workout_context: Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas' Gravel roads forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 111 miles.
72ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas' demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
At mile 60 of 111, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
At Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas. Train it until it feels boring.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
8,000ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
8,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 8,000ft of climbing on mixed gravel does to your power file on race day.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 111 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas’s 111 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at Belgian Waffle Ride Kansas demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride mixed gravel at race-day cadence weekly. Expect: gravel roads. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Dial in tire pressure before race week — 5 PSI wrong costs you 15+ minutes over 111 miles.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 111 miles of mixed gravel in Lawrence, Kansas.
